tools.name: router_status
tools.description: Live Codvian Router status: listen address, provider/model counts, gateway-key count, whether the auto-router is configured, and uptime when known.

tools.name: provider_list
tools.description: List the providers configured in the router (id, name, wire format, enabled, models, catalog id, verification). Never includes base URLs or API keys.

tools.name: model_list
tools.description: List every model offered by the configured providers (id, provider id, provider name). Virtual auto/* models are listed when the auto-router is configured.

tools.name: best_combo_for_task
tools.description: Recommend a combo for a task, ranked on measured ledger metrics (success rate, cost per request, mean latency) and the task's strategy preference (coding tasks prefer code, fast tasks fastest, cheap tasks cheapest). A combo with no history ranks on strategy match alone and is reported as metrics-unknown. A cost/latency constraint a combo cannot be checked against (unknown price, no latency) does not exclude it — the result reports the constraint as not applied for that combo.

tools.name: cache_flush
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: evict the caller's own cached entries only. The tenant is the authenticated caller, never an argument — other tenants' entries are untouched. Requires mcp:manage:cache AND mcp:destructive.

tools.name: check_quota
tools.description: Quota position for one gateway key from the real ledger: the rolling 5-hour budget (limit, priced spend, remaining, at-limit) plus the daily/weekly/monthly calendar windows and the unpriced-usage policy. A key with no budget is unlimited (has_budget=false, no invented cap). A gateway-key caller may only check its own key id (omit it, or pass your own id — another key's id is rejected).

tools.name: cost_report
tools.description: Cost report from the real ledger and price book: requests, tokens, and priced cost over a window, per model. Usage whose price is unknown is reported as UNKNOWN (cost_known=false, unpriced tokens/models listed), never as $0. The local operator may omit key_id for all keys or name any key; a gateway-key caller may only report on its own key id (omit it, or pass your own id — another key's id is rejected).

tools.name: create_combo
tools.description: Create a routing combo: a named ordered list of providers (members may carry a reasoning effort as "provider@effort") with a routing strategy. The combo is written to the config routing groups (and the chain-strategy mirror) and persisted to the config file. Members must be configured providers; the strategy must be a known strategy name or a combo execution mode (fusion, pipeline, jev).

tools.name: db_health
tools.description: Health of the router's data-dir databases (ledger, feedback, persistent cache): whether each file exists, opens, and its known tables count cleanly.

tools.name: explain_route
tools.description: Explain how a model would be routed: the effective strategy and its rule, and the attempt order over the providers offering the model (declared order). Dry run — no provider is called. Strategies that re-rank do so at request time from live signals this tool does not observe; the result says so. Optionally restrict the order to one combo's members.

tools.name: get_combo_metrics
tools.description: Measured ledger history for one combo's member providers (all time): requests, successes, errors, success rate, tokens, cost, and mean latency over recent successful events (at most the 500 most recent events — older events do not affect the mean). Cost is a lower bound when any of the combo's tokens are unpriced (cost_known=false) — unpriced usage is never reported as $0.

tools.name: heartbeat
tools.description: Live liveness snapshot: server uptime, announced tool count, protocol version, and audit-log state (enabled/disabled). Read-only; calls no provider.

tools.name: list_combos
tools.description: List every configured routing combo (config routing groups) with its members, strategy, and whether it is the session-active combo. Read-only.

tools.name: memory_add
tools.description: Store a free-text memory under the caller's own namespace in the local file-backed memory store. No embeddings, no external service — the text is stored as written.

tools.name: memory_clear
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete all of the caller's own stored memories. Other callers' memories are untouched. Requires mcp:manage:memory AND mcp:destructive.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search the caller's own stored memories by case-insensitive substring match. Results are ranked by occurrence count, then recency — the returned matches field is the raw occurrence count, not a relevance score.

tools.name: pick_fastest_model
tools.description: Pick the fastest model by MEASURED mean latency over recent successful ledger events. With no measured latency it errors honestly instead of guessing from prices or catalog order; when the latency backend itself is unavailable, the error says the backend is unavailable. Optionally restrict to one provider.

tools.name: set_budget_guard
tools.description: Set a budget guard for one gateway key in the real ledger: a rolling 5-hour USD cap (limit_usd, required, >= 0), optional calendar daily/weekly/monthly USD caps, and the unpriced-usage policy (fail_closed by default — a capped key refuses unpriced models; count_as_zero lets them through counting $0). The guard applies to spend from the moment it is set; existing usage history is untouched. A gateway-key caller may only guard its own key id (omit it, or pass your own id — another key's id is rejected).

tools.name: set_routing_strategy
tools.description: Set the routing strategy: globally (no chain) or for one chain (a model id, or a combo/group name). The strategy must be a known strategy name. The change is written to the config and persisted to the config file.

tools.name: simulate_route
tools.description: Dry-run a route for a model: the fallback tree (one attempt per target, in order, with what happens when each fails) and the first-attempt prompt-cost estimate from the real price book when prompt_tokens is given. No provider is called. Completion cost is never estimated (the completion length is unknown before the call). Unpriced targets report cost_known=false, never $0.

tools.name: switch_combos
tools.description: Set the session-active combo (the default combo the routing tools report). The serving router has no single active combo — every group is always addressable — so this selects the MCP session's default only; it never changes what the serving router routes. Pass active=false to clear the active selection.

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Search the registered MCP tool catalog by name or description substring; returns matching tools with their descriptions and required scopes. An empty query returns the full catalog.

notes: tool_search under deny-2: returns 30 visible tools (cache_stats and db_stats denied).
